title: What Skyworks Solutions Holders Got Right
summary: Skyworks Solutions spent this past year working to close a US$22b merger with Qorvo, lining up debt financing, buybacks, and even suspending its dividend as regulators weighed in. For Skyworks Solutions shareholders, the return over the past year was 20.5%, including dividends. If you had been deciding on 20 November 2025 whether to buy, what would you have needed to believe about this deal, given the later collapse in net margin to 2.2% by Q4 2026?
